prompt:
Classify the user message as a customer support ticket. Read the whole message, whether in English, Swedish or German. Match the issues by meaning and keep their original mention order.

Routing directory
billing — charges, payments, invoices, receipts, prices, payment methods and refunds of charges
technical — help setting up, connecting, configuring or using a product, app or website that isn't reported broken
account_access — sign-in, passwords, two-factor codes, locked or blocked accounts
shipping — order delivery, including tracking, delays, changing or checking the delivery address, or a missing parcel
returns — sending a physical item back, return labels, exchanges and the return window
cancellation — ending a subscription or plan or stopping automatic renewal
feature_request — a request for functionality the product doesn't currently have
bug_report — malfunction of the product, app or website: a crash, error code, freeze or feature that stopped working
privacy — what personal data is stored, obtaining a copy, deleting it, how it's shared or GDPR requests
partnership — business proposals such as reselling, co-marketing, integrations, sponsorship or volume deals
feedback — praise, opinions or complaints that don't ask for help or action
other — a message unrelated to the company's products and services

For a single issue, select its label. For multiple issues, use this lookup first; the pair can occur in either order:

Issue pair | Condition | Winner
billing + technical | payment, charge or invoice mentioned | billing
billing + bug_report | payment, charge or invoice mentioned | billing
cancellation + billing | wants to end a subscription | cancellation
cancellation + returns | wants to end a subscription | cancellation
privacy + account_access | asks about or wants deletion of their personal data | privacy
privacy + cancellation | asks about or wants deletion of their personal data | privacy

If no row decides the result, select the label of the issue mentioned first. Return exactly one directory label, spelled as shown. Do not translate it or add quotes, punctuation, explanation or a question.
